findings.rootCause: The one-time Google Identity Services authorization-code popup originates from the exact Firebase Hosting Preview origin. Google rejects the request before account selection because that exact scheme+host is not registered as an Authorized JavaScript origin for the OAuth web client.
findings.remediation: Add only the exact current B2 Preview origin to the existing OAuth web client's Authorized JavaScript origins, preserving client ID/secret, redirect URIs, production origins and production secrets. Then repeat the one-time administrative Drive bootstrap on the same exact Preview.
findings.durableFollowup: After R85/R84 proof closes, replace run-ID-dependent OAuth bootstrap origins with one stable dedicated administrative bootstrap surface/channel so future forensic runs do not require additive OAuth-origin churn.

findings.rootCause: The UI state labeled Restaurando sesión spans more than session restoration. It also waits membership, tenant/read authority and full authoritative hydration of eight required business collections before revealing the product shell. This conflates identity readiness with data readiness and makes startup latency visible as an authentication delay.
findings.remediation: Preserve fail-closed identity, membership, tenant and role/scope validation, but separate AUTH_READY from DATA_ROUTE_READY. Reveal the authenticated shell once identity/access authority is proven; hydrate non-critical business collections and route-specific data afterward with bounded loading states. Add milestone timing so regressions are measured rather than hidden behind one splash.
guardrails: Do not show protected data before its authoritative route readiness

Do not promote to LIVE from this finding

r87Execution.conclusion: The available CI identity can be elevated reversibly for read-only OAuth config visibility, but no documented/supported programmatic surface exposed the existing web client's Authorized JavaScript origins for additive update. Google documentation directs this setting through Google Auth Platform > Clients. Further blind use of private/guessed endpoints or granting OAuth Config Editor is not authorized.
